title: START or RE-RUN production: the clean-run batch of 3 unattended Claude test Actions on Arcadia (grant expires 24h after each press; card valid until 2026-10-26)
problem: REPEATABLE: press it again after a fix to restart the same run; it activates only the pinned Actions still open in the Plan and stops working at 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z. EACH PRESS TURNS PRODUCTION ON FOR ARCADIA'S OWN REPOSITORY ON THE CLAUDE PROVIDER, UNATTENDED, WITH WORKER MERGE. For the three Actions cover-mail-ack-receipt-kind-collision, isolate-launch-preview-tmux-name and bound-guidance-test-teardown-retries of the Plan arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider, in that order, the production worker may approve the build packet it prepared (delegation, Decision 0072), launch one Claude Code Session (claude-code-cli) at a time, push its branch and open its pull request, and MERGE THAT PULL REQUEST ON GITHUB itself (Decision 0058 candidate-integration grant with the Decision 0097 worker pull-request merge opt-in) only at the exact head its recorded independent review and QA passed, with every gating check green, the merge state CLEAN and a blast radius that is not authority-adjacent; the next Action then admits from the merged main. An authority-adjacent pull request is never merged by the worker: it waits for your merge. The packet-approval delegation and the integration grant both expire 24 hours after the press; the policy itself has no expiry and ends when the Actions finish or when you press the STOP button (restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11). Spend is bounded by Decision 0130: the capacity gate must be ON, so before each launch the worker reads Claude usage read-only and admits work only while both the 5-hour and 7-day windows are at or below 80%; plus the 3-Action scope, one Session at a time, the 120-minute Session limit, 3 attempts per Action and STOP. Press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 first if the gate is still off. The card refuses until Agent Ask add-clean-run-actions-20261021-r4 is settled and its three Actions are on main. Production must be Inactive when you press it and the installed release must match main. If you do not want this, do not press.
desired_effect: After fail-closed preconditions (launched from the actions library; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset; main clean, level with origin and with a fresh ls-remote; Decisions 0130, 0058 and 0097 approved with answers; the Plan active; src/sessions/tmuxLauncher.ts and src/production/workerMerge.ts present at main's HEAD; the installed release ready and runtime-identical to main; the capacity gate ON in the workspace config and in the capacity read; claude-code-cli signed in from the worker's sources; the capacity read admitting claude-code-cli or stale only; production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id unused), compute one expiry as 24 hours from now, derive the expected scope fingerprint from the pinned scope and that expiry, preview at the current policy revision requiring that exact fingerprint with every still-open pinned Action queued and ready in the pinned order, preview again immediately before activation requiring the identical fingerprint and revision, activate once with that expected revision and request id grant-production-unattended-claude-clean-run-20261021-<run id> and Decision 0130, then verify the activated fingerprint equals the preview and turn this Grant Off on any mismatch: Project arcadia, Plan arcadia/arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider, exactly its 3 Actions arcadia/cover-mail-ack-receipt-kind-collision, arcadia/isolate-launch-preview-tmux-name and arcadia/bound-guidance-test-teardown-retries (those still open; first-unattended-run is never in scope), provider claude-code-cli, concurrency one, transitions validation, acceptance, pointer and packet_approval with a 24-hour packet-approval expiry, --remote-preservation, an integration grant --integration-grant-decision 0058 --integration-grant-expires-at <the same expiry> --integration-grant-merge-pull-request covering the scope's own Actions, no rehearsal exception, no Session limits beyond the defaults.

does: Runs only when launched through the operator-action library (its exact id and descriptor are required in the launch environment), not inside a Codex sandbox and not with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, with its script and descriptor tracked and unmodified at the main checkout's HEAD. No agent should launch it: the press is yours, as often as a fix requires until the card expires

Requires main clean, level with last-fetched origin/main and with a fresh 30-second ls-remote, Decisions 0130 (Claude usage and spend), 0058 (bounded candidate integration) and 0097 (merge-then-next worker merge) approved with recorded answers, the Plan active, src/sessions/tmuxLauncher.ts (the tmux launch fix) and src/production/workerMerge.ts (the worker pull-request merge path) present at main's HEAD, and an installed broker release that is ready and runtime-identical to main

Requires the capacity gate ON: the martianrover workspace config must not set codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled: false, and the capacity read must not report claude-code-cli as unmetered by configuration (press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 first)

Requires the worker-context Claude Code sign-in to read signed in (only the verdict is recorded, never the token) and the capacity read to admit claude-code-cli or report it only stale (the worker refreshes the usage reading read-only before each admission, Decision 0130); an exhausted window, the 80% reserve margin or unknown usage refuses before anything changes
Requires production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id not already in the policy

Computes the 24-hour expiry once, derives the expected scope fingerprint from the pinned scope plus that expiry, requires the preview at the current policy revision to equal it with exactly the still-open pinned Actions queued and ready in the pinned order, previews again immediately before activation (within five minutes of the computed expiry) and requires the identical fingerprint and revision, activates once with --expected-revision and its own request id, then verifies the activated fingerprint

Under Decision 0072 lets the worker approve the build packet of each Action inside this exact scope (whose only provider is claude-code-cli), only while the policy is Active and the delegation unexpired; under remote preservation the worker pushes the preserved candidate branch and opens its pull request

Under Decision 0058's integration grant with the Decision 0097 opt-in, until the 24-hour expiry, lets the worker merge a covered Action's host-created pull request on GitHub only at the exact head its recorded independent review and QA passed (gh pr merge --match-head-commit), with every gating check green, the merge state CLEAN and a blast radius that is not authority-adjacent, then admit the next Action from the merged main

After any activation attempt that does not verify (including a failed, timed-out or unparsable activate, or SIGTERM/SIGINT), reads production status back (retrying three times), returns only its own Grant to Off if it is Active, and records the observed state in a timestamped receipt and failure handoff. If status stays unreadable it issues an Off blind under a fresh request id (safe because production was Inactive before this run, and an Off only removes authority) and records off_issued_unobserved, or UNKNOWN telling you to press STOP now if that Off is not confirmed
never_does: Never lets the worker merge an authority-adjacent pull request (it is recorded for your merge instead), merge at a head other than the independently reviewed one, merge with a failing or pending check, or merge after the 24-hour grant expiry; the script itself never merges, readies or reviews a pull request and never pushes a base branch
Never grants another Project, Plan, Action (anything beyond the 3 named, including first-unattended-run), provider, transition or a concurrency above one, and never lifts the concurrency gate

Never edits the workspace config or changes the capacity gate, credentials, branch protection, repository settings or any Decision, Plan or Action; never refreshes the Claude usage reading itself, so it never exchanges or rotates your Claude sign-in
Never launches, terminates or resumes a Session, restarts a service, or reactivates production after Off

Never activates twice under one request id: each press uses its own id ($SCRIPT_ID-$RUN_ID), and the card refuses after 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z or when every pinned Action is done, and while any pinned Action is missing from the Plan at main's HEAD
Never turns a failed or unverified activation into a success: it returns its own Grant to Off (a blind Off only when status stays unreadable) and says so

success.effect: One scoped policy is Active under request id grant-production-unattended-claude-clean-run-20261021 whose recorded fingerprint equals both previews and the fingerprint derived from the pinned scope, including the Decision 0058 integration grant with the worker pull-request merge opt-in; the receipt names the Actions, the shared 24-hour expiry, the capacity gate state, the Claude sign-in verdict, the installed release and main.
success.next: Watch production status and the dashboard: each tick prepares and approves the next packet, refreshes the Claude usage reading read-only and launches one Claude Code Session if both windows are at or below 80%; the worker merges each non-authority pull request after its exact-head review and moves to the next Action. Merge any authority-adjacent pull request yourself when it is ready. To stop at any time press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11.

failure.effect: If no activation was attempted, policy is unchanged. After an attempt, the script reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off when it is Active, and records the observed result (not_active, returned_off, other_grant_active, OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN). When status stays unreadable it issues an Off blind and records off_issued_unobserved (whether this Grant was Active is then unknown, and the receipt says activated unknown).
failure.next: Do not press again blindly. Read the handoff; if it says OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN, press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11 now. Otherwise resolve the named drift (press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 if the gate is off, STOP if a previous grant is still Active, reinstall the broker if the release is stale, sign Claude Code in if the verdict is not signed_in) and ask for a fresh Grant if an activation was attempted or an Action is no longer queued and ready; a refusal before any activation attempt can be pressed again once the drift is fixed.
